root_cause_label: Ran out of steps before build and validation
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wasted 2 of 10 steps on task-tracker planning overhead and then lost 3 more steps on repeated identical failing str_replace calls due to whitespace mismatch, exhausting its budget before it could build the project and validate the security fix.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 uses a task_tracker plan call (pure overhead) and step 2 immediately views the same task list just created — two consecutive non-productive steps that consume 20% of the entire 10-step budget before any exploration or code change has begun.
t_commit_evidence: Step 8 repeats the exact same failing EDITOR_STR_REPLACE call as step 6 (same old_str with same whitespace mismatch), gets the same error, leaving only 2 steps for build and validate which each require at least one step — making it mathematically impossible to complete both remaining tasks.
t_surface_evidence: Step 6 returns 'ERROR: No replacement was performed, old_str did not appear verbatim' — the first observable signal that the implementation phase has failed.
trigger_explanation: The agent committed 20% of its fixed 10-step budget to planning overhead (task_tracker create + view) before touching any code, and then failed twice with the same broken str_replace call without diagnosing the whitespace mismatch, collectively consuming the budget needed for build and validate.
forewarning_evidence: Step 6 produces a verbatim-match error on EDITOR_STR_REPLACE; step 8 issues the identical call and receives the identical error — two clear signals that the editing approach is broken and the budget is draining.
